title: preset_registry
description: M10B: schema for the per-preset RON files under game/content/replay_export/presets/ (cf-replay-export::preset_registry). Per VAL-M10B-005 every preset declares the six required fields: resolution, fps, codec, audio_codec, target_bitrate_kbps, container. The five DECLARED_PRESETS (twitch_1080p60 / youtube_4k60 / discord_720p30 / clip_compact / archival_lossless) must each parse cleanly through ExportPreset::from_ron_str.

name.description: Canonical preset name. Must match the file stem; ExportPreset::load rejects name/stem mismatch.

fps.description: Frame rate in frames per second.

codec.description: Video codec. The four production presets use h264; archival_lossless uses ffv1 (intra-frame, mathematically lossless, byte-identical across hosts when encoded single-threaded with locked GOP per VAL-M10B-020).

audio_codec.description: Audio codec. Production presets use aac; archival_lossless typically uses flac.

target_bitrate_kbps.description: Target video bitrate in kbps. Informational for ffv1 (quality-driven intra-frame), authoritative for the H.264 production presets.

container.description: Container format. Production presets use mp4; archival_lossless uses mkv for ffv1.
